meta.requirement: Explore Stormbearer Mountains (10%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Something Ancient
start.text:
''You cut across a narrow side path where the scrub opens onto a shelf of flat stone. Red Valberry clusters glint along the ridge. Quiet up here, except it is not.''

''A little girl stands frozen ten paces ahead, wicker basket clutched to her chest. Beyond her, something massive and wrong is unfolding itself from the rock face. Plates of rusted metal scrape against stone. A single eye, pale and unblinking, locks onto her and does not move away.''

''The Ruin Guard takes one heavy step forward. The girl does not scream. She just stops breathing.''

grt_between.text:
''You move before you finish thinking about it. The girl flinches at your footfall, then scrambles behind a boulder without a word. Smart kid.''

''The Ruin Guard rotates toward you instead. Ancient gears grind. Its fist rises, slow and certain, like it has done this a thousand years and intends to do it once more.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the Ruin Guard threatening the girl on the mountain trail

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Fight the Ruin Guard. Defeat 1 [[Ruin Guard]]

kill_ruin_mf.text:
''The Ruin Guard collapses in a shower of sparks and dead metal. The eye goes dark. For a long moment the only sound is the wind and your own breathing.''

''From behind the boulder, a small voice:''

Mina: ...Is it dead?

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Talk to the girl you saved

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Talk to the Girl

talk_to_girl.text:
''The girl peeks out, then steps into the open. She cannot be older than nine. Berry stains on her sleeves, dirt on her knees, eyes very wide and very steady.''

Mina: You fought the big one. ''looks at the wreckage, then back at you'' Mama says those things sleep in the old ruins. This one was not sleeping very well.

''She sets her basket down and counts out four Valberries with solemn care, checking each one twice before she holds them out.''

Mina: Mama also says thank-you should cost something. I picked these today. They are the good ones. ''beat'' Please take them.

girl_saved.title: Girl Saved
girl_saved.text:
Mina: ''nods, satisfied that the transaction is complete''

Mina: Go down the main trail if you are heading back. The wet stones on the shortcut lie. ''very seriously'' I know because I stepped on one.

''She scoops up her basket and sets off downslope at a careful hobble, already planning her story for Mama.''
